Body.Content:
Businesses that sell small, low-value items, such as fasteners, electronic components or packaging, can maintain prices more easily and accurately, without rounding problems from tiny per-unit prices.

With this feature, Unified Pricing Management supports price units, so you can set a price per batch of units instead of per single unit. For example, you can price an item per 100 or 1,000 units. Unified Pricing Management then calculates the correct line amount from the order quantity.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
